title: UK Believes Iran Played a Part in RAF Fairford Air Base Incident, Burnham Says
summary_full: The British prime minister, Andy Burnham, said there were “strong indications” Iran played a part in the events at R.A.F. Fairford on Sunday, without providing details why.
